positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior Software Engineer and frequent Project Lead for Office Docs team primarily based in Cambridge, MA.  The team has focused on creating a consistent experience for common collaborative features across the various applications in Microsoft Office, and in recent years the team has been primarily working on Microsoft Loop and Microsoft 365 Copilot.  I currently serve as Project Lead for on-canvas Copilot and Page History in Microsoft 365 Copilot.  I am also currently Accessibility driver within my team, helping engineers to improve the product for users of assistive technologies.

Previous projects I've been involved with within the team include: Project Lead for on-canvas Copilot and Page Summary in Loop, Project Lead for Comments across various platforms/apps in Office, Improving the Share feature in Office for Windows, Project Lead for the People Hub in the ribbon in Office for Windows (and other related features), Project Lead for the Share feature within Office Mobile, enhancing the File menu in Office Online, the social features of SharePoint 2013, and miscellaneous work in SharePoint Workspace 2010.

Additionally, I volunteered for College Puzzle Challenge (a former Microsoft-run puzzle competition for college students) as puzzle author and as local event coordinator for assorted schools (ex. Cornell, Harvard, MIT, Brown, Boston University, Northeastern, Olin) for the 2010-2017 events.  I also volunteered as intern social coordinator, organizing morale events for local interns, for the summers of 2014-2020.

Counselor for 6 weeks at Program in Mathematics for Young Scientists for talented high school students with a strong interest in mathematics

I was a student in the program during each of the 3 summers prior to being a counselor.
